## Purpose

Describe the gate, experiment, issue, or ADR this change advances.

## Evidence

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New behavior has positive and negative tests
- [ ] Dependency and toolchain revisions are immutable
- [ ] Result claims identify their evidence class

## Risk

- [ ] Security and privacy impact considered
- [ ] No secrets or customer payloads in fixtures or artifacts
- [ ] API, ABI, wire, schema, and compatibility impact described
- [ ] Rollback or experiment stop condition described
